messages:
Maria Chen: FYI customer CS-9872 is hitting repeated 500s + p95 latency spikes. They attached a curl repro and a trace id. Need to gather a sanitized debug bundle for eng. Request IDs: req_20260315_9ef3, req_20260315_9ef4
Josh Patel: paste the curl here and I'll try to repro in staging. Also need workspace id and confirm whether payload has emails/CCNs/phones
Maria Chen: curl below. NOTE: token is redacted here but full request in customer's logs may contain emails in the prompt — do NOT forward raw.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b", "input":"Hi, here's the prompt with user@example.com inside..."}'
```
Dmitri Ivanov: I'll pull the trace for req_20260315_9ef3. infra-bot, please queue the debug bundle for that req id.
infra-bot: debug bundle queued: DB-6248 for req_20260315_9ef3 (estimated ready in ~5m)
Alice Nguyen: Sanitation checklist before handing to eng: 1) Replace Authorization header with "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" 2) Mask emails/phones/SSNs/addresses (replace with [REDACTED]) 3) Replace internal user IDs with anonymized tokens (user_123 -> user_xxxx) 4) Strip attachments >5MB and list their filenames 5) Keep minimal prompt sample (1-2 lines) that preserves structure but not content
Josh Patel: When you upload, include exact repro steps: model (rwd-3b), sequence length, expected vs observed (e.g., p95=2.1s, p50=0.6s), and which environment you ran the curl in (staging/prod).
Maria Chen: I'll sanitize and upload to s3/eng-debug/CS-9872/DB-6248-sanitized.tar.gz and paste link here once done. Tagging @Dmitri @Josh to confirm that's sufficient.
Alice Nguyen: If any prompts include legal or PHI content, completely redact those chunks and note "redacted for compliance" in the bundle README.
Josh Patel: Also include raw request/response headers (with Authorization masked) and the server side logs around the request timestamp. Small log snippets OK — no full dumps in channel.
Maria Chen: Uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/eng-debug/CS-9872/DB-6248-sanitized.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
Dmitri Ivanov: grabbing the bundle now, starting triage. Will DM if I need the unredacted bundle (following access controls).
support-bot: ticket CS-9872 updated: Eng assigned (Dmitri), priority=P2
Maria Chen: thanks team :pray:
